scope: Two separate rendered uncooked native game processes. Road creation/save and fresh-process load, terrain collision, RCP spline-mesh surface physics, clearance/regrowth of measured ShaderWorld instance origins.
measurement_limits: Three matching SHA1 fingerprints cover complete valid world-space instance matrices, sorted independently of slot order; CPU transform stability is not a render-thread completion fence.
Core counts cover instance origins within 350 cm of the planned spline in XY; positive reference controls are 1000 to 3000 cm away. No leaf, branch, crown or roadside overhang clearance proof.
Shared render-buffer CPU matrices are read under DataLock; removed/invalid slots and hidden collision clones are excluded. GetInstanceCount alone is not the acceptance metric.
No direct GPU biome-mask pixel readback, Cook, packaged build or Shipping test.

The native Slate-key UI test validates R/Enter, Backspace, X, Q/E, K/L and normal PIE auto-load. Camera movement used ActorTools; WASD/right mouse/wheel and F5/F9 aliases are not accepted. A PIE restart is not a fresh OS process; the native verification run supplies that separate proof.
sources: Own combined runtime-roads-test.json and create/load phase reports in original UnrealMcpTest, 28 October 2026; field-whitelist export omits process IDs, nonce, slot and local paths.
Source/UnrealMcpTest/CityLabRoadVerification.cpp, CityLabRoadGameMode.h/.cpp, CityLabRoadSurfaceComponent.h/.cpp and CityLabPersistence.h/.cpp in original project; not redistributed.

legacy_format_test.fixture: Synthetic version-1 save constructed by the current verifier; migrated to linear terrain-only roads with no surface mesh.
legacy_format_test.scope_limit: Does not prove loading an archived save produced by a historical executable.

manual_input_test.scope: Actual native Slate keys in PIE; camera translated by ActorTools between two cursor points. Normal PIE restart; cold-process proof separately in runtime-roads-test.json.
manual_input_test.method: Actual native Slate click/key events in PIE; camera translated using ActorTools between the two cursor points, not with tested movement keys.
